# TRU SIGNAL

Offline, non-LLM **comms card** for when the phone and the net are gone. One self-contained HTML file. No accounts, no telemetry, no generated wording.

**Live app (after Pages is on, branch main / root):** https://splashdown1.github.io/tru-signal/

Lifeline keeps a body alive. Canonbound keeps the Word. Signal is how you are found, and how two people who cannot hear each other still share one meaning.

## What it answers from

| Lane | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Distress | COLREGS Annex IV distress signals; international arm signal | Treaty / standard facts, not a paraphrase of a copyrighted manual |
| Panels | FAA AIM 6-2-6 survivor ground-air code; FM 21-60 (30 Sep 1987) pilot replies | US government work |
| Phonetic | ICAO / NATO spelling alphabet | Standard word list |
| Morse | ITU International Morse | Standard code |
| Arm | FM 21-60 Visual Signals, 30 Sep 1987, only figures quoted from the public-domain text | US government work |

Honest gap: if a meaning is not in the packed lanes, the page says so. It does not invent a signal.

## Use

Open `index.html` in any browser. Works offline after the first load. Search a letter, a word, or a need (`sos`, `medical`, `halt`, `yes`). Morse practice is local only.
